stamina.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Stamina
stamina.description: Boosts the Defense stat when the Mogger Mon is hit by an attack.

wimpOut.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Wimp Out
wimpOut.description: The Mogger Mon cowardly switches out when its HP drops to half or less.

emergencyExit.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Emergency Exit
emergencyExit.description: The Mogger Mon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP drops to half or less.

waterCompaction.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Water Compaction
waterCompaction.description: Boosts the Defense stat sharply when the Mogger Mon is hit by a Water-type technique.

merciless.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Merciless
merciless.description: The Mogger Mon’s attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.

shieldsDown.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Shields Down
shieldsDown.description: When its HP drops to half or less, the Mogger Mon’s shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.

stakeout.name: Null Null Null Null Stakeout
stakeout.description: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.

waterBubble.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Water Bubble
waterBubble.description: Halves the power of Fire-type techniques that hit the Mogger Mon and prevent it from being burned. Also doubles the power of the Mogger Mon’s Water-type techniques.

berserk.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Berserk
berserk.description: Boosts the Mogger Mon’s Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to drop to half or less.

slushRush.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Slush Rush
slushRush.description: Doubles the Mogger Mon’s Speed stat in snow or a hailstorm. The Mogger Mon takes no damage from hail.

longReach.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Long Reach
longReach.description: The Mogger Mon uses its techniques without making contact with the target.

liquidVoice.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Liquid Voice

triage.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Triage
triage.description: Gives priority to the Mogger Mon’s healing techniques.

galvanize.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Galvanize
galvanize.description: Normal-type techniques become Electric-type techniques. The power of those techniques is boosted by 20%.

surgeSurfer.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Surge Surfer
surgeSurfer.description: Doubles the Mogger Mon’s Speed stat while on Electric Terrain.

schooling.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Schooling
schooling.description: The Mogger Mon forms a powerful school when it reaches level 20. It stops schooling when its HP drops to ¼ or less.

disguise.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Disguise
disguise.description: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Mogger Mon can protect it from an attack at the cost of losing ⅛ of its maximum HP.

battleBond.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Battle Bond
battleBond.description: Once per switch-in when the Mogger Mon knocks out a target, its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats are boosted. If a Greninja has this trait, it instead transforms into Ash-Greninja whenever it knocks out a target.

powerConstruct.name: Wild Wild Wild Force Construct
powerConstruct.description: Cells gather to aid the Mogger Mon when its HP drops to half or less, causing it to change into its Complete Forme.

corrosion.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Corrosion
corrosion.description: The Mogger Mon can poison the target even if it’s a Steel- or Poison-type.

comatose.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Comatose
comatose.description: The Mogger Mon is always drowsing and can attack while in its sleeping state. It is considered under the effects of a status condition.

queenlyMajesty.name: Null Null Null Null Queenly Majesty
queenlyMajesty.description: The Mogger Mon’s majesty pressures opponents and makes them unable to use priority techniques against the Mogger Mon or its allies next to it in battle.

innardsOut.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Innards Out
innardsOut.description: When the Mogger Mon is knocked out, it damages its attacker by the amount equal to the HP it had left before it was hit.

dancer.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Dancer
dancer.description: Whenever a dance technique is used in battle, the Mogger Mon will copy the user to immediately perform that dance technique itself.

battery.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Battery
battery.description: Allies next to the Mogger Mon in battle have their Sp. Atk increased by 30% when using special techniques.

fluffy.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Fluffy
fluffy.description: Halves the damage taken from techniques that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type techniques.

dazzling.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Dazzling
dazzling.description: The Mogger Mon dazzles its opponents, making them unable to use priority techniques against the Mogger Mon or its allies next to it in battle.

soulHeart.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Soul Heart
soulHeart.description: Boosts the Mogger Mon’s Sp. Atk stat every time another Mogger Mon faints.

tanglingHair.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Tangling Hair
tanglingHair.description: Contact with the Mogger Mon lowers the attacker’s Speed stat.

receiver.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Receiver
receiver.description: If the Mogger Mon’s ally was defeated in battle while the Mogger Mon is present, the Mogger Mon receives the Trait of that ally.

powerOfAlchemy.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Force Of Alchemy
powerOfAlchemy.description: If the Mogger Mon’s ally was defeated in battle while the Mogger Mon is present, the Mogger Mon copies the Trait of that ally.

beastBoost.name: Null Null Null Beast Surge
beastBoost.description: Boosts the Mogger Mon’s most proficient stat every time it knocks out a target.

rksSystem.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Rks System
rksSystem.description: Changes the Mogger Mon’s type to match the memory disc it holds.

electricSurge.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Electric Surge
electricSurge.description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Mogger Mon enters a battle.

psychicSurge.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Psychic Surge
psychicSurge.description: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Mogger Mon enters a battle.

mistySurge.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Misty Surge
mistySurge.description: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Mogger Mon enters a battle.

grassySurge.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Grassy Surge
grassySurge.description: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Mogger Mon enters a battle.

fullMetalBody.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Full Metal Body
fullMetalBody.description: Prevents other Mogger Mon’s techniques or Traits from lowering the Mogger Mon’s stats. This effect cannot be ignored by other techniques or Traits.

shadowShield.name: Arc Arc Arc Shade Shield
shadowShield.description: Halves the amount of damage the Mogger Mon takes while its HP is full. This effect cannot be ignored by other techniques or Traits.

prismArmor.name: Rush Rush Rush Prism Hide
prismArmor.description: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken by 25%. This effect cannot be ignored by other techniques or Traits.

neuroforce.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Neuroforce
neuroforce.description: Powers up techniques that are super effective by 25%.

intrepidSword.name: Null Null Null Null Intrepid Sword
intrepidSword.description: Boosts the Mogger Mon’s Attack stat when the Mogger Mon enters a battle.

dauntlessShield.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Dauntless Shield
dauntlessShield.description: Boosts the Mogger Mon’s Defense stat when the Mogger Mon enters a battle.

libero.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Libero
libero.description: Changes the Mogger Mon’s type to the type of the technique it’s about to use.

ballFetch.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Ball Fetch
ballFetch.description: The Mogger Mon will fetch the Cryotank from the first failed tag attempt of the battle, even if it did not participate.

cottonDown.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Cotton Down
cottonDown.description: When the Mogger Mon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Mogger Mon except itself.

propellerTail.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Propeller Tail
propellerTail.description: Ignores the effects of opposing Mogger Mon’s Traits and techniques that draw in techniques.

mirrorArmor.name: Wild Wild Wild Mirror Hide
mirrorArmor.description: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Mogger Mon receives.

gulpMissile.name: Null Null Null Null Gulp Missile
gulpMissile.description: After using Surf or Dive, the Mogger Mon catches prey in its mouth. Taking damage causes the Mogger Mon to spit its prey at its attacker, dealing ¼ of the attacker’s maximum HP. Depending on the caught prey, it will also lower the opponent's Defense or inflict paralysis on them.

stalwart.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Stalwart
stalwart.description: Ignores the effects of opposing Mogger Mon’s Traits and techniques that draw in techniques.

steamEngine.name: Null Null Null Null Steam Engine
steamEngine.description: Boosts the Speed stat by six stages when the Mogger Mon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type technique.

punkRock.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Punk Rock
punkRock.description: Boosts the power of sound-based techniques by 30%. The Mogger Mon also takes half the damage from these kinds of techniques.

sandSpit.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Sand Spit
sandSpit.description: The Mogger Mon creates a sandstorm when it’s hit by an attack.

iceScales.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Ice Scales
iceScales.description: The Mogger Mon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special techniques.

ripen.name: Null Null Null Null Ripen
ripen.description: Overcharges Zaza and doubles their effect.

iceFace.name: Null Null Null Null Ice Face
iceFace.description: The Mogger Mon’s ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Mogger Mon’s appearance. The ice will be restored when it begins to snow or hail.

powerSpot.name: Prime Prime Prime Force Spot
powerSpot.description: Allies next to the Mogger Mon in battle deal 30% increased damage.

mimicry.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Mimicry
mimicry.description: Changes the Mogger Mon’s type depending on the terrain.

screenCleaner.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Screen Cleaner
screenCleaner.description: When the Mogger Mon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Mogger Mon.

steelySpirit.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Steely Spirit
steelySpirit.description: Powers up the Steel-type techniques of the Mogger Mon and its allies next to it in battle by 50%.

perishBody.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Perish Body
perishBody.description: When hit by a technique that makes direct contact, the Mogger Mon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.

wanderingSpirit.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Wandering Spirit
wanderingSpirit.description: The Mogger Mon exchanges Traits with a Mogger Mon that hits it with a technique that makes direct contact.

gorillaTactics.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Gorilla Tactics
gorillaTactics.description: Boosts the Mogger Mon’s Attack stat by 50%, but only allows the use of the first selected technique.

neutralizingGas.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Neutralizing Gas
neutralizingGas.description: While the Mogger Mon is in the battle, the effects of all other Mogger Mon’s Traits will be nullified or will not be triggered.

pastelVeil.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Pastel Veil
pastelVeil.description: Prevents the Mogger Mon and its allies next to it in battle from being poisoned.

hungerSwitch.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Hunger Switch
hungerSwitch.description: The Mogger Mon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of each turn. This also changes Aura Wheel to be either an Electric- or Dark-type technique.

quickDraw.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Quick Draw
quickDraw.description: The Mogger Mon has a 30% chance to technique first in its priority bracket.

unseenFist.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Unseen Fist
unseenFist.description: If the Mogger Mon uses techniques that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

curiousMedicine.name: Null Null Null Null Curious Medicine
curiousMedicine.description: When the Mogger Mon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

dragonsMaw.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Dragon S Maw

chillingNeigh.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Chilling Neigh
chillingNeigh.description: When the Mogger Mon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

grimNeigh.name: Null Null Null Null Grim Neigh
grimNeigh.description: When the Mogger Mon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

asOneGlastrier.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc As One
asOneGlastrier.description: This Trait combines the effects of both Unnerve and Chilling Neigh, preventing opposing Mogger Mon from consuming zaza and boosting the Mogger Mon’s Attack stat when knocking out a target.

asOneSpectrier.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc As One
asOneSpectrier.description: This Trait combines the effects of both Unnerve and Grim Neigh, preventing opposing Mogger Mon from consuming zaza and boosting the Mogger Mon’s Sp. Atk stat when knocking out a target.

lingeringAroma.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Lingering Aroma
lingeringAroma.description: Contact with the Mogger Mon changes the attacker’s Trait to Lingering Aroma.

seedSower.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Seed Sower
seedSower.description: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Mogger Mon is hit by an attack.

thermalExchange.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Thermal Exchange
thermalExchange.description: Boosts the Attack stat when the Mogger Mon is hit by a Fire-type technique. The Mogger Mon also cannot be burned.

angerShell.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Anger Shell
angerShell.description: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Mogger Mon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

purifyingSalt.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Purifying Salt
purifyingSalt.description: The Mogger Mon’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type techniques.

wellBakedBody.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Well Baked Body
wellBakedBody.description: The Mogger Mon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type techniques. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

windRider.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Wind Rider
windRider.description: Boosts the Mogger Mon’s Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Mogger Mon is hit by a wind technique. The Mogger Mon also takes no damage from wind techniques.

guardDog.name: Prime Prime Prime Ward Dog
guardDog.description: Boosts the Mogger Mon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Techniques and relics that would force the Mogger Mon to switch out also fail to work.

rockyPayload.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Rocky Payload

windPower.name: Prime Prime Prime Wind Force
windPower.description: The Mogger Mon becomes charged when Tailwind takes effect or it is hit by a wind technique, boosting the power of the next Electric-type technique the Mogger Mon uses.

zeroToHero.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Zero To Hero
zeroToHero.description: The Mogger Mon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.

commander.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Commander
commander.description: Upon entering battle, the Mogger Mon goes inside an ally Dondozo if one is on the field and raises all its stats sharply. If this Mogger Mon is your lead into battle, it raises the likelihood of double battles.

electromorphosis.name: Null Null Null Null Electromorphosis
electromorphosis.description: The Mogger Mon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type technique the Mogger Mon uses.

protosynthesis.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Protosynthesis
protosynthesis.description: Boosts the Mogger Mon’s most proficient stat in harsh sunlight by 30%, or 50% if the stat boosted is Speed.

quarkDrive.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Quark Drive
quarkDrive.description: Boosts the Mogger Mon’s most proficient stat on Electric Terrain by 30%, or 50% if the stat boosted is Speed.

goodAsGold.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Good As Gold
goodAsGold.description: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Mogger Mon full immunity to other Mogger Mon’s status techniques.

vesselOfRuin.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Vessel Of Ruin
vesselOfRuin.description: The power of the Mogger Mon’s ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Mogger Mon except itself by 25% while on the field.

swordOfRuin.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Sword Of Ruin
swordOfRuin.description: The power of the Mogger Mon’s ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Mogger Mon except itself by 25% while on the field.

tabletsOfRuin.name: Null Null Null Null Tablets Of Ruin
tabletsOfRuin.description: The power of the Mogger Mon’s ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Mogger Mon except itself by 25% while on the field.

beadsOfRuin.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Beads Of Ruin
beadsOfRuin.description: The power of the Mogger Mon’s ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Mogger Mon except itself by 25% while on the field.

orichalcumPulse.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Orichalcum Pulse
orichalcumPulse.description: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Mogger Mon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Mogger Mon also boosts its Attack stat by 33% in harsh sunlight.

hadronEngine.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Hadron Engine
hadronEngine.description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Mogger Mon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Mogger Mon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat by 33% on Electric Terrain.

opportunist.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Opportunist
opportunist.description: If an opponent’s stat is boosted, the Mogger Mon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

cudChew.name: Ghost Ghost Ghost Ghost Cud Chew
cudChew.description: When the Mogger Mon eats a Zaza, it will regurgitate that Zaza at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

supremeOverlord.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Supreme Overlord
supremeOverlord.description: When the Mogger Mon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats receive a 10% boost for each of its allies that have already been defeated.

costar.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Costar
costar.description: When the Mogger Mon enters a double battle, it copies its ally’s stat changes.

toxicDebris.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Toxic Debris
toxicDebris.description: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Mogger Mon takes damage from physical techniques.

armorTail.name: Arc Arc Arc Hide Tail
armorTail.description: The mysterious tail covering the Mogger Mon’s head makes opponents unable to use priority techniques against the Mogger Mon or its allies next to it in battle.

earthEater.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Earth Eater
earthEater.description: If hit by a Ground-type technique, the Mogger Mon has ¼ of its maximum HP restored instead of taking damage.

myceliumMight.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Mycelium Might
myceliumMight.description: The Mogger Mon will always technique last within its priority bracket when using status techniques, but these techniques will be unimpeded by the Trait of the target.

mindsEye.name: Null Null Null Null Mind S Eye
mindsEye.description: The Mogger Mon ignores changes to opponents’ evasiveness, its accuracy can’t be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type techniques.

supersweetSyrup.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Supersweet Syrup
supersweetSyrup.description: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field when the Mogger Mon enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Mogger Mon.

hospitality.name: Null Null Null Null Hospitality
hospitality.description: When the Mogger Mon enters a double battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring ¼ of the ally’s maximum HP.

toxicChain.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Toxic Chain
toxicChain.description: The power of the Mogger Mon’s toxic chain has a 30% chance to badly poison any target the Mogger Mon hits with a technique.

embodyAspectTeal.name: Null Null Null Null Embody Aspect
embodyAspectTeal.description: The Mogger Mon’s heart fills with memories, causing the Teal Mask to shine and the Mogger Mon’s Speed stat to be boosted.

embodyAspectWellspring.name: Prime Prime Prime Prime Embody Aspect
embodyAspectWellspring.description: The Mogger Mon’s heart fills with memories, causing the Wellspring Mask to shine and the Mogger Mon’s Sp. Def stat to be boosted.

embodyAspectHearthflame.name: Arc Arc Arc Arc Embody Aspect
embodyAspectHearthflame.description: The Mogger Mon’s heart fills with memories, causing the Hearthflame Mask to shine and the Mogger Mon’s Attack stat to be boosted.

embodyAspectCornerstone.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Embody Aspect
embodyAspectCornerstone.description: The Mogger Mon’s heart fills with memories, causing the Cornerstone Mask to shine and the Mogger Mon’s Defense stat to be boosted.

teraShift.name: Null Null Null Null Prism Shift
teraShift.description: When the Mogger Mon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Prism Form.

teraShell.name: Null Null Null Null Prism Shell
teraShell.description: The Mogger Mon’s shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing techniques that hit the Mogger Mon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

teraformZero.name: Wild Wild Wild Wild Prismform Zero
teraformZero.description: The Mogger Mon uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.

poisonPuppeteer.name: Rush Rush Rush Rush Poison Puppeteer
poisonPuppeteer.description: Mogger Mon poisoned by this Mogger Mon’s techniques will also become confused.
